items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: Well, I always connected Don Bias with the brothers, Doug Bascom and his brother.

ctx.x: I thought they were from Birmingham. They may be, I know. I know that Don was around there or something. Don Bias? Yeah, there's so many Midwestern musicians.
Well, I always connected Don Bias with the brothers, Doug Bascom and his brother. They may have been, I don't know.
